    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # For each horizontal edge segment, project its midpoint inward.
    for r in range(h):
        cols=[c for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v==8]
        if len(cols)>1 and (r==0 or r==h-1):
            c=(min(cols)+max(cols))//2
            dr=1 if r==0 else -1
            rr=r+dr
            while 0<=rr<h:
                if grid[rr][c]==7:
                    g[rr][c]=4; break
                g[rr][c]=8; rr+=dr
    return g
''')
